notes.title: 🛠 Changelog v0.4.02
notes.notes:
2025-08-26

[b][/b]
[h2][b]🏆 Achievements System[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] ✨ Full achievements system integrated into the game!
[*] 🎉 Achievement unlock popup animations display your accomplishments in style.
[*] 📊 Progress tracking shows exactly what you need to unlock each achievement.
[*] ☁️ Steam achievements fully integrated and automatically uploaded.
[*] 📈 Dual progress tracking system using both Steam stats and in-game system.
[*] 🆕 Achievement unlocks now appear in the novelties section.
[*] 🎮 Steam API configuration completed for seamless achievement synchronization.
[*] 🔗 Quick access link to achievements added in the main menu.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]🎯 In-Game Improvements[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] 👻 Ghost ship no longer appears when starting from the editor.
[*] 🎯 Crosshair automatically fades out at low speeds for cleaner visuals.
[*] 🔧 Complete reorganization and refactoring of the in-game UI system.
[*] 🎁 Sequential reward display shows all earned rewards directly in-game.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]🚗 Garage Customization[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] 🎨 Fresh color palette with new selectable colors.
[*] 🔒 Lock symbols indicate locked spaceship parts.
[*] ℹ️ Clickable lock symbols provide unlock requirement information.
[*] 📊 Percentage display shows spaceship component properties.
[*] 🔓 Revised unlock progression for spaceship parts and colors.
[*] 📐 Grid system features darker lines without cross overlapping.
[*] 🎨 Active paint job clearly highlighted for easy identification.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]📱 Menu UI Updates[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] 🎮 Mission rating system now fully supports controller navigation.
[*] 🕹️ Scroll containers optimized for smooth controller input.
[*] 🌍 All tab menu names translated for international players.
[*] ✨ More UI elements feature shiny hover and focus effects.
[*] 🏅 Chapter rank display added to the missions overview screen.
[*] 🌐 Website button integrated into the main menu.
[*] 💫 Various small UI adjustments for improved user experience.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]📹 Replay List Interface[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] 📏 Improved spacing after column headers for better readability.
[*] 🎮 Full controller support for navigation.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]👤 Profile Page[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] ⏳ Loading text displayed during color and name updates.
[*] 🎨 Player name styled with chosen player color.
[*] 📐 Better spacing between follow buttons and mission sharing options.
[*] 📝 Column headers added for improved organization.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]🗺️ Mission Overview[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] 📚 Enhanced spacing between chapters for clearer navigation.
[*] 🟡 Hovered mission tiles highlighted in yellow.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]🎮 Demo Version[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] ⚡ Features showcased more quickly to new players.
[*] 🏁 Enemy records now visible in the demo version.
[*] 💙 "Wishlist on Steam" reminder when closing the game.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]🛠️ Editor Updates[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] 🖱️ Editor mouse properly accounts for big UI scaling.
[*] 🎮 Editor manual mode fully supports controller input.
[*] 🕹️ Right-side editor menu navigable with controller.
[*] 🐛 Fixed hover detection issue occurring every second frame.
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]⚖️ Legal & Compliance[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] 📜 Terms of Service and Privacy Policy integrated.
[*] 🔍 Research completed for complaint functionality regarding player names (Digital Service Act compliance).
[/list]
[b][/b]
[h2][b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] ⚡ Fixed issue with player getting permanently stuck when stunned.
[*] 🔧 Numerous minor bugs squashed for smoother gameplay.
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog v0.3.14
notes.notes:
[h3]System[/h3]
[list]
[*]Updated to [b]Godot Engine 4.4[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added [b]DestroyableGenerator[/b] (a destructible map tile)
[*]Players can now choose a [b]custom color[/b] for their name label
[*]Added [b]Playtest invite link[/b] from the demo version
[*]New songs added: [i]Safe Zone[/i] and [i]Space Attack[/i] by Josh Kashdan
[*]Game now explains [b]required completion time[/b] when player is too slow
[*]Background and foreground elements now appear [b]blurred and darkened[/b]
[*]Editor: [b]Colorize[/b] function made clearer and can now be removed
[*]Bug report menu now accessible [b]in-game[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Settings[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added [b]keyboard keybinding customization[/b]
[*]Added [b]rebindable controller inputs[/b] with sensible layout
[*]New toggle setting for [b]V-Sync[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed: [b]TriggerLoop[/b] triggered one extra time unexpectedly
[*]Fixed crash when disbanding a group with no group selected
[*]Fixed: Editor mouse cursor stayed in [b]scale mode[/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Changelog v0.3.13
notes.notes:
[h3]Editor Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added folder management buttons and improved tile property system
[*]Enhanced controller support with tooltips and a [b]Joywheel[/b]
[*]Improved validation for tile properties and menu entries
[/list]
[h3]Replays & Mission Runs[/h3]
[list]
[*]Replays are now automatically created and stored on the server
[*]Improved validation and integrity checks for MissionRuns
[*]Added [b]global ranking tab[/b] and replay filtering
[*]New settings: [b]Auto-save successful & failed replays[/b]
[/list]
[h3]RigidBody2D Doors[/h3]
[list]
[*]Converted doors to RigidBody2D
[*]Improved collision handling and [b]damage mechanics[/b] for crushing objects
[*]Fixed [b]lighting and sound effects[/b]
[/list]
[h3]User Interface (UI)[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a [b]new in-game menu[/b] and [b]video mode settings[/b]
[*]Improved [b]Big UI Mode[/b] compatibility
[*]Introduced [b]hierarchical back navigation[/b] instead of browser-style back
[*]Configurable [b]in-game camera zoom[/b]
[*]Various [b]translation updates[/b] and UI bug fixes
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay & Features[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added [b]GoldOre Collector[/b] and finalized spaceship stats
[*]Removed [b]credit system[/b] & [b]campaign history system[/b], keeping only high scores
[*]Adjusted [b]campaign unlocks and awards[/b]
[*]Enhanced [b]tractor beam visuals[/b] and [b]hull colorization shaders[/b]
[*]New [b]high-score challenge[/b] for levels up to [b]Chapter 8[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Mission Adjustments[/h3]
[list]
[*][b]Welcoming Mission[/b]: Gates now open when taking off
[*]Improved [b]goal mechanics[/b] and [b]gate indicators[/b]
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed [b]cannon shots passing through objects, trophy timing issues, UI inconsistencies, and ship layout saving[/b]
[*]Improved [b]pause menu behavior, component purchases, and background layer positioning[/b]
[*]Fixed [b]garage ship preview, engine fire flickering, fuel refill menu, and ranking display[/b]

notes.title: Changelog v0.3.10
notes.notes:
System:
    • Set OpenGL as default video driver
Gameplay:
    • Laps Counter now count up (e.g., Lap 2/3) instead of down
    • Enhanced visual effect for side thrusters
    • Remove throttle control with joystick, only steering
    • Add finish line to some missions
Controller:
    • Add shortcuts in menu: "Start" navigates to Missions
    • Add shortcuts in menu: "Reset" button navigates to Garage 
Menu:
    • Email input is now optional
    • Text Adjustments
    • SpinBox for FPS adjustment
    • Fix Bug: Ship dies were not buyable
Editor:
    • Tile Properties Tooltips added for better understanding
    • Add menu entry to open mission folder in OS file browser
    • UI/UX Enhancements
    • Bug Fixes
